name: Fully local assets
prose: `default-src 'none'` with `style-src`/`script-src`/`font-src` all `'self'`: nothing is fetched from the web at runtime, so the app works offline and in an air-gapped environment. Both bundled fonts are SIL OFL 1.1 with the licence text and copyright notices shipped alongside them (`app/renderer/fonts/`).
invariant: default-src 'none' with style/script/font all 'self': nothing is fetched from the web at runtime, so the app works air-gapped.
